title: ReverseEngineering: Update UI strings for consistency
body:
ReverseEngineering: Update UI strings for consistency

@sifabiancic @FreeCAD/design-working-group

ground_truth.body: Consider using standard ASCII characters for consistency and compatibility. While the Unicode ellipsis is visually appealing, some systems or tools may not render it correctly.
Consider using std::make_shared instead of raw 'new' for improved safety and adherence to modern C++ practices.
Consider using standard ASCII triple-dot notation (...) instead of Unicode ellipsis (…) for improved compatibility across various terminals and encodings.
Tooltip text lacks specificity on segmentation criteria; update to state it creates separate mesh segments based on surface types per documentation.
Tooltip text should be updated to "Performs Poisson surface reconstruction" for clearer user guidance.

Tooltip text uses a noun phrase instead of the expected action-oriented verb form; update from "Triangulation of structured point clouds" to "Triangulates structured point clouds" for consistency with UI conventions.
